class.name: NetwPropertySetBinding
class.description: Created for each node that calls [method Netw.configure_property]. [member set] describes the properties, and this object reads them from the node.

method.name: carry_channel_of
method.description: Returns the [method NetwPropertyConfig.carry_along] property of [param property], or empty.

method.name: converge_stiffness_of
method.description: Returns the [method NetwPropertyConfig.converge] value of [param property], or [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: epsilon_override_of
method.description: Returns the [method NetwPropertyConfig.epsilon] of [param property], or a negative value when unset.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while the node is in the tree and this peer sends its properties.

method.name: is_windowed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when each send repeats past ticks, as set by [method NetwPropertyConfig.windowed].

method.name: node
method.description: Returns the node, or [code]null[/code] once it is freed.

method.name: property_class_of
method.description: Returns the [enum NetwPropertySet.PropertyClass] of [param property], or [constant NetwPropertySet.CAUSAL] when unset.

method.name: teleport_at_of
method.description: Returns the [method NetwPropertyConfig.teleport_at] of [param property], or a negative value when unset.

members.member: The index of the node within its entity. [code]0[/code] is the entity root.

Called after received values are applied, as [code]on_applied(header)[/code]. [codeblock lang=text] Dictionary ┠╴ordinal int the index of the set ┠╴tick int the tick of the values ┠╴ack int the last input the server used ┠╴payload Array the values ┖╴samples Array past ticks, only for a windowed set [/codeblock]
A key that sorts bindings the same way on every peer.
The route of the entity, or [code]0[/code] before it spawns.
